data.title: Apple Early iPhone Demand Supports Buy/Outperform Rating, Price Target Maintained at $380
data.description:
Analyst Amit Daryanani from Evercore ISI maintained a Buy rating on Apple and keeping the price target at $380.00.

Amit Daryanani has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily the strong early demand indications for Apple’s new iPhone lineup. The sharp extension of iPhone Duo delivery times to roughly 100 days across all tracked regions and configurations signals broad-based customer interest, reinforcing confidence in Apple’s ability to drive robust upgrade cycles and revenue growth.

He also notes that lead times for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are generally stable or improving as Apple processes launch orders, with longer waits for the Pro Max underscoring sustained premium-mix strength. Taken together, these datapoints support his decision to maintain an Outperform stance and keep the price target unchanged at $380, reflecting an attractive risk-reward profile for AAPL shares.
